performance.verdict: Spend is live but attribution is broken — 11 conversions invisible to system.

findings.text: lead_drought flag is a tracking failure, not a lead failure: Google Ads logged 11 conversions over 28 days while the system reads 0 leads — pixel or CRM handoff is broken.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — overdue 2026-08-31; speed-to-lead automations may point at an empty seat, blocking scale-up gate.
Booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31), Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA re-enable (heating, due 2026-09-01) all overdue — 5 milestones undelivered.
GBP actions collapsed -82.05% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs a prior-3-day average of ~1 — organic demand signal has gone dark.
GHL returned a 401 timeout error this run — pipeline data is unavailable, so intake leak vs ads problem cannot be separated until CRM is accessible.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tag and GHL lead handoff immediately — 11 conversions are invisible to system, CPL is uncalculable.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 11 conversions over 28 days ($1,062.10 spend) but the system reads 0 leads — CPL is entirely uncalculable. Audit the Google Ads conversion tag, the GHL webhook endpoint, and resolve the GHL 401 timeout. Success check: system lead count matches Google Ads conversions within 10% by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat assignment — unblocks scale-up gate and speed-to-lead automations overdue since 2026-08-31.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake owner role remains unconfirmed as of 2026-09-04, blocking the SOW scale-back-up gate. Identify the replacement, grant their GHL login, and confirm after-hours coverage. Success check: named owner with active GHL login confirmed in writing to Nacer by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 consecutive days vs 45-day average ~3.5/day — re-check after 2026-09-07 for recovery.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been 0 for the last 3 days (2026-09-01 through 2026-09-03) against a 45-day daily average of roughly 3.5 actions, and the 7-day delta is -82.05%. This may reflect Windsor data lag at the tail of a reporting window, per SOW guidance, or a genuine organic demand drop. Re-check on 2026-09-07; if actions remain at or near 0 after lag clears, escalate to GBP profile review.
